bug_description.original: Detailed report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5763541525594112 Project: skia Fuzzer: libFuzzer_skia_api_raster_n32_canvas Fuzz target binary: api_raster_n32_canvas Job Type: libfuzzer_asan_skia Platform Id: linux Crash Type: Stack-buffer-overflow WRITE 4 Crash Address: 0x7f8f45277361 Crash State: sk_bzero void Fuzz::next<unsigned int> void Fuzz::nextRange<unsigned int, unsigned int, unsigned int> Sanitizer: address (ASAN) Recommended Security Severity: High Regressed: https://oss-fuzz.com/revisions?job=libfuzzer_asan_skia&range=201811060415:201811070409 Reproducer Testcase: https://oss-fuzz.com/download?testcase_id=5763541525594112
bug_description.normalized: OSS-Fuzz issue 11291: Fuzz::nextEnum unconditionally casts the destination pointer of any enum type T to uint32_t*, then Fuzz::next<uint32_t> writes sizeof(uint32_t)=4 bytes via sk_bzero. When T is an enum with a smaller underlying type (e.g. SkPaint::Style declared as enum : uint8_t, sizeof=1), this overflows the stack-allocated variable by 3 bytes. The fix replaces the hardcoded uint32_t cast with skstd::underlying_type_t<T>, so the write size matches the enum's actual underlying type.

source.description: PoC bytes (6 bytes) are wrapped into a Fuzz object with fBytes->size()=6 and fNextByte=0. The fuzz data drives execution through fuzz_RasterN32Canvas → fuzz_canvas → fuzz_paint to the vulnerable make_fuzz_t_range<SkPaint::Style> template instantiation.
source.value_from: PoC file bytes passed by libFuzzer as (data, size); value `data, size`; from `auto fuzz = Fuzz(SkData::MakeWithoutCopy(data, size));`

sink.description: sk_bzero(n, sizeof(T)) with T=uint32_t writes 4 bytes via memset to the 1-byte stack variable 'value' (SkPaint::Style : uint8_t), overflowing 3 bytes past the allocation. ASan reports: stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 4 at offset 33 into [32, 33) 'value'.

root_cause.description: nextEnum casts the T* pointer to uint32_t* regardless of T's actual underlying type. When T=SkPaint::Style (enum : uint8_t, 1 byte), this creates a type-size mismatch: subsequent operations (nextRange → next) treat the 1-byte destination as a 4-byte uint32_t buffer. The patch replaces uint32_t with skstd::underlying_type_t<T> to use the correct type.

tainted_value_origin.description: Attacker-controlled PoC bytes are wrapped into the Fuzz object that drives all subsequent data consumption.

parser_admitted.description: Fuzz data has been consumed through fuzz_RasterN32Canvas → fuzz_canvas (case 32) → fuzz_paint to reach make_fuzz_t_range<SkPaint::Style>(fuzz, 0, 2). By this point the 6-byte input is exhausted (fNextByte=6=fBytes->size()), but the loop has not returned because fuzz->exhausted() was checked before the drawCommand consumption that exhausted it.

coarse_trace.summary: PoC bytes (6 bytes) are wrapped into a Fuzz object and passed to fuzz_RasterN32Canvas.
A 1-byte stack local of type SkPaint::Style (enum : uint8_t) is declared and passed to Fuzz::nextEnum.
nextEnum casts the 1-byte SkPaint::Style pointer to uint32_t* (4 bytes) and forwards to nextRange, creating a type-size mismatch.

next<uint32_t> evaluates (fNextByte + sizeof(uint32_t)) > fBytes->size() as true (input exhausted), enters the exhaustion branch, and calls sk_bzero(n, 4) on the 1-byte stack variable, causing a 3-byte stack-buffer-overflow.

fine_trace.note: PoC bytes (data, size=6) are wrapped into Fuzz object: fBytes->size()=6, fNextByte=0. Execution proceeds through fuzz_RasterN32Canvas → fuzz_canvas → fuzz_paint, consuming all 6 bytes before reaching the vulnerable call.
Declares a stack local of type SkPaint::Style (enum Style : uint8_t), sizeof(value)==1. ASan confirms: stack frame object [32, 33) 'value' — a single addressable byte at offset 32.

Casts SkPaint::Style* (1-byte enum) to uint32_t* (4-byte). All downstream operations (nextRange → next) now treat the destination as a 4-byte buffer. The patch replaces uint32_t with skstd::underlying_type_t<T> (resolves to uint8_t for SkPaint::Style), eliminating the mismatch.

T=uint32_t, sizeof(T)=4. Evaluates (fNextByte + 4) > 6 as true because prior fuzz consumption (fuzz_canvas next(&useDAA) + nextRange(&N) + nextRange(&drawCommand), then fuzz_paint next(bool)×2 + next(SkColor) + nextEnum(SkBlendMode) + nextEnum(SkFilterQuality)) has exhausted the 6-byte input (fNextByte==6). Enters the exhaustion branch that reaches sk_bzero.

T=uint32_t, sizeof(T)=4. Calls memset(n, 0, 4) where n is the 1-byte stack local 'value' at frame offset 32. Writes 4 bytes to a 1-byte allocation: 3-byte stack-buffer-overflow. ASan intercepts at __asan_memset and reports WRITE of size 4.

crash_stack.function: Fuzz::nextRange<unsigned int, unsigned int, unsigned int>
